title.narrative: Supporting the water and sanitation sector in IDP camps in Somalia

description.narrative: Improving access to sanitation facilities in displaced communities by constructing toilets in targeted areas in Somalia, leading to improved health, hygiene practices, and socio-economic development.
Improving sanitation and hygiene services in IDP camps by establishing toilets that are accessible to people with disabilities.

Reduce morbidity and mortality among women, girls, boys and men affected by crises from preventable diseases, by improving water, sanitation and hygiene services in health care facilities and improving service delivery in health care facilities through safe water supplies.
